requirements.statement: && and || require Boolean left/right operands and Boolean result; invalid operand positions are static errors.
requirements.formal: historical-static-rule-presence-only; no current conformance or backend theorem
remaining_obligations: Field is the bounded non-Boolean representative; arbitrary types and combinations remain unqualified. Further conformance expansion is time-boxed, then deferred to the next milestone.
requirements.formal_limit: Only a related historical static typing rule is identified, not evaluation/failure/recording/proof correspondence.
requirements.observed_frontend_scope: Both operand positions of &&/|| reject Field on both targets; literal false&&Field and true||Field remain static errors; Boolean controls compile.

requirements.statement: OR evaluates left once; true skips right and returns true; false evaluates right once and returns it.
remaining_obligations: Native finite Boolean cases accepted in ADR0348. Source typing, composition beyond this fixture and recording/observed/proof behavior retain separate obligations.
requirements.assertion_scope: One executed test contains both the pure call/assert loop at lines 63–72 and subsequent witnessed checks; its name does not restrict it to witnessed calls.
requirements.observed_native_scope: All four pure OR pairs and identity-witness pairs; first-call refusal, selected second-call refusal and skipped second-call refusal. Inverted-answer controls establish use of returned witness value.

requirements.statement: AND evaluates left once; false skips right and returns false; true evaluates right once and returns it.
remaining_obligations: Native finite Boolean cases accepted in ADR0348. Source typing, composition beyond this fixture and recording/observed/proof behavior retain separate obligations.
requirements.assertion_scope: One executed test contains both the pure call/assert loop at lines 63–72 and subsequent witnessed checks; its name does not restrict it to witnessed calls.
requirements.observed_native_scope: All four pure AND pairs and identity-witness pairs; first-call refusal, selected second-call refusal and skipped second-call refusal. Inverted-answer controls establish use of returned witness value.

requirements.statement: Negation requires Boolean, evaluates operand once and flips its value.
requirements.formal: historical-static-rule-presence-only; no current conformance or backend theorem
remaining_obligations: Non-Boolean source refusal is observed for Field. Other source types, recording/observed/proof behavior and other operand compositions retain separate obligations.
requirements.formal_limit: Only a related historical static typing rule is identified, not evaluation/failure/recording/proof correspondence.
requirements.assertion_scope: One executed test contains both the pure call/assert loop at lines 63–72 and subsequent witnessed checks; its name does not restrict it to witnessed calls.
requirements.observed_native_scope: Both pure and witnessed values, both witnessed operand refusals, and inverted-answer cases execute with exactly one callback on the operand.
requirements.observed_frontend_scope: !Field rejected on both public targets with exact Boolean-guard diagnostic; Boolean NOT control compiles.

requirements.statement: Conditional guard is Boolean; source branches are comparable; result is their supertype and both branches are statically checked.
requirements.formal: historical-static-rule-presence-only; no current conformance or backend theorem
remaining_obligations: Mixed-width, alias and aggregate source joins and supertype results remain individually unqualified; no comparable-type universe claim. Further conformance deferred after the bounded time box.
requirements.formal_limit: Only a related historical static typing rule is identified, not evaluation/failure/recording/proof correspondence.
requirements.observed_frontend_scope: Field guard, Boolean/Field branch incompatibility in both arm positions, and invalid !Field in each literal-unselected arm reject on both targets. Boolean conditional controls compile.

requirements.statement: Evaluate guard once and exactly one selected arm; even equal arms retain observable guard effects.
remaining_obligations: Equal-arm true/false/refusal cases are observed; full8 Boolean triple table and selected/skipped arm witness/errors are not exhaustively joined.

requirements.statement: Statement if uses Boolean guard, executes then or else, and performs no body when false with no else.
remaining_obligations: Statement-to-expression lowering source identified; a dedicated statement-form true/false/no-else execution join remains unknown.

requirements.statement: Condition failure halts before arms; selected-arm failure halts the circuit; skipped-arm failure is not evaluated.
remaining_obligations: Ternary selected/skipped arm errors, Compact assertion failures beyond witness refusal, arbitrary external-effect rollback and recorded/proof behavior remain unqualified.
requirements.observed_native_scope: Generated source &&/|| and ! preserve exact witness refusal and stop callback evaluation at the failed operand; skipped RHS refuses if called but is not called.

requirements.statement: Nested logical and conditional expressions preserve selected left-to-right evaluation through bindings and calls.
remaining_obligations: Nested ternary/call fixtures exist but no finite seed-tree bound or per-obligation execution join is claimed in this initial map.

requirements.statement: Native behavior, recording/observed API admission, proof applicability and executed proof are separate obligations.
remaining_obligations: Native-only effect fixture must remain unavailable for recorded/proof-ready APIs. Existing recorded conditional profiles need their own exact transcript/gas/proof receipts; pure truth values cannot qualify them.

Rust 1.99.0 locked/offline native execution of checked-in generated crate: all pure AND/OR pairs and NOT values; identity witness successes, selected/skipped/first-call refusals, and six inverted-answer controls. Explicit callback/private-state and canonical transcript assertions. No fresh compiler regeneration, TS run, recording/replay/proof or formal theorem; no failed-context/rollback claim.

Both public TS/Rust targets: eight valid Boolean expressions in one compiled module per target, twelve exact source/type rejections per target (26 compiler invocations). Field is one non-Boolean representative. Uses source-qualified prior compiler/Scheme binaries, not a fresh build; same shared frontend is not an independent second semantics oracle. No native execution, recording, replay, proof or general comparable-type join claim.
